newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault still in talks on Russia venture.
newsitem.headline: Renault still in talks on Russia venture.

text.p: Renault SA is in talks to establish a possible venture to assemble Megane cars at the Moscow-owned Moskvitch plant and sell them in Russia, but no agreement has been struck yet, a Renault spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
"Nothing is decided. Nothing has been signed. We're just in discussions," she said after a visit by Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin to Renault's Paris headquarters.

The talks, first announced in June, grew out of an accord signed in February entailing the delivery of Renault engines to the Moskvitch plant. The spokeswoman said that contract was not operational because the financing had not been set.
It hinges on an agreement between the French and Russian finance authorities.
